name: Content Marketing Strategy
headline: Content Marketing Strategy: Resources & Guides
short_description: The helpful and in progress list of how to do content marketing and great content marketing resources, guides, templates
author: dshanley

sections.overview:
This skill provides a structured collection of content marketing resources, guides, and best practices sourced from industry leaders. It covers strategy fundamentals like topic selection, content volume planning, and funnel-stage optimization, alongside practical resources for SEO, messaging, buyer personas, and competitive positioning. The collection includes curated links to courses, frameworks for building content flywheels, analytics guidance, and comparative marketing examples. Marketing leaders, content strategists, and SaaS marketers use this resource to plan campaigns, organize sales enablement content, and benchmark against competitor approaches.
Planning a content marketing strategy from scratch using proven frameworks
Determining optimal content volume and topic selection for audience conversion
Building SEO-optimized content across all funnel stages
Creating buyer personas and product messaging templates
